hints: Treat each arrival as +1 customer and each leaving time as -1.
Sort events by time and keep a running number inside.
All times are distinct, so event order at equal times is not a concern.
analogy: A running headcount changes by one whenever someone enters or exits.
example: Customers [2,4), [3,9), [5,8): the count reaches 2 from time 3 until time 4, so maximum is 2.
algorithm: Create (time,+1) arrival and (time,-1) departure events, sort them, scan the active count, and retain its maximum.
correctness: At every event the running total equals the people present just after that distinct event time; checking all event intervals captures the maximum.
complexity: O(n log n) time and O(n) event space.
